synopsis.text: A group of four young men have a conversation in an outdoor courtyard, with close-ups showing their reactions and gestures.

paragraph.text: Four young men stand together in an outdoor courtyard with white columns. One man in a blue and red varsity jacket speaks and gestures while the others listen. The camera cuts between close-ups of the speakers and the listeners. One of the men in a white jersey pulls out a pen and gestures with it. Another man places his hand on the speaker's shoulder. The conversation continues with close-ups of the men facing each other.
